corrections.reason: After removing the narrower DSSP-T parent, the proposed definition supplies no compact-turn condition. Central torsions and optional H-bond alone do not delimit beta turns.
corrections.proposed_definition: A local four-residue backbone turn with a compact, nonhelical central conformation; an i-to-i+3 backbone hydrogen bond may be present.
corrections.proposed_structural_definition: In the PROMOTIF operational definition, four consecutive residues i through i+3 form a beta turn when the C-alpha atoms of i and i+3 are separated by less than 7 angstroms and the two central residues are nonhelical. Subtypes are classified by the central backbone torsions; the end-to-end hydrogen bond is optional.
corrections.implementation_note: Retain SO0001133 mapping and cite the manual alongside it. Treat the distance test as the named operational convention, not a newly invented universal numerical ontology axiom.

corrections.reason: DSSP T is a residue-assignment state, whereas topology_string represents a normalized element arrangement. Subsequent motif classification is not required to identify the T assignment itself.
corrections.proposed_method_name: DSSP coordinate-based assignment of the T turn state
corrections.implementation_note: If existing rendering requires topology_string for compatibility, retain it temporarily but add ss_string and state that it is symbolic class notation, not a measured sequence. Keep PPII/version differences outside this bounded T-state repair.

corrections.reason: Several proposed evidence notes contain curation instructions such as remove or move. Convert these to source-specific scientific support statements; keep unresolved actions in discussions or the review dossier.

example_replacements.BETA_ALPHA_BETA: The documented motif requires parallel paired strands joined through a helix; the E-H-E token alone does not encode strand pairing.
example_replacements.BETA_HAIRPIN: The two strands are antiparallel and paired; the connecting loop need not be a four-residue beta turn.
example_replacements.BETA_TURN: The geometric beta-turn convention can include motifs without the end-to-end hydrogen bond required by the narrower DSSP T assignment.
